entries.title: ResearchPilot AI
entries.description: A scalable AI-powered research assistant that processes large volumes of documents using retrieval-augmented generation.
entries.impact: Processed 1000+ documents and improved contextual response accuracy by 35%.
entries.details: Built a RAG pipeline using semantic chunking and vector embeddings. Integrated LLaMA models for contextual generation and evaluated retrieval quality using precision-recall metrics.
entries.challenges: Maintaining retrieval relevance and handling diverse document structures.
entries.solutions: Optimized embedding strategies and semantic search pipelines.

entries.title: PulseConnect
entries.description: AI-driven blood demand forecasting and donor matching system.
entries.impact: Reduced emergency response time by 40% and improved donor matching efficiency by 30%.
entries.details: Designed a multi-agent system using real-time Firebase streams. Implemented ensemble regression models with hyperparameter tuning for accurate predictions.

entries.title: StartupConnect
entries.description: A full-stack platform that connects users with relevant opportunities using AI-based matching.
entries.impact: Improved relevant job-role matching by 25% for 100+ users.
entries.details: Built role-based authentication and implemented similarity-based matching algorithms for personalized recommendations.

entries.title: DevOps CI/CD Automation
entries.description: Automated CI/CD pipelines with integrated testing and monitoring.
entries.impact: Improved deployment reliability and enabled early defect detection.
entries.details: Integrated API validation scripts into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous system health and consistent deployments across environments.

entries.title: MarketNest
entries.description: A fashion marketplace platform with automated testing workflows.
entries.impact: Ensured UI consistency and reliable user experience through automation.
entries.details: Automated end-to-end user flows using Selenium WebDriver, covering form validation and navigation testing.

entries.title: Pizza Sales Analytics Dashboard
entries.description: Developed an interactive business intelligence dashboard to analyze pizza sales performance, customer purchasing trends, and revenue metrics.
entries.impact: Analyzed 50,000+ sales records and enabled data-driven decision making through KPI tracking and trend analysis.
entries.details: Imported and transformed sales data from SQL Server using Power Query. Designed interactive dashboards with KPI cards, revenue trends, category-wise sales analysis, top-selling pizzas, order patterns, and customer insights. Implemented DAX measures for revenue, average order value, total orders, and sales growth analysis.
entries.challenges: Handling data inconsistencies and optimizing dashboard performance for large datasets.
entries.solutions: Applied data cleaning and transformation techniques in Power Query and created optimized DAX calculations for faster reporting.
